query: select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'works',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id),'[]') from public.works t where id between 987107001 and 987107999),'editions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id),'[]') from public.editions t where work_id between 987107001 and 987107999),'authors',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id),'[]') from public.authors t where id in(select author_id from public.works where id between 987107001 and 987107999))) as readback;
